blocks.text: A module is a file of Python code, such as functions, variables and classes, that can be reused in other parts of a program. To create one, write the code in a file and save it with the .py extension.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.text: Running main.py imports greetings, calls its function and prints 'As-Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!'.
